description: Defines the class AndroidLightField, a lightweight implementation of a Java field used within the IntelliJ IDEA plugin for Android development. It provides methods for field properties, modifiers, and presentation.

classes.name: AndroidLightField
classes.description: A lightweight PSI representation of a Java field for Android plugin development, supporting property access, modification, and presentation.

methods.name: AndroidLightField
methods.description: Constructor initializing the light field with name, context class, type, final modifier, and constant value.

methods.name: isEquivalentTo
methods.description: Checks if this field is equivalent to another PSI element.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the containing class of the field.

methods.name: getContainingFile
methods.description: Returns the file containing the context class.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets a new name for the field.

methods.name: computeConstantValue
methods.description: Returns the constant value of the field if any.

methods.name: setInitializer
methods.description: Sets the initializer expression for the field.

methods.name: getInitializer
methods.description: Returns the initializer expression.

methods.name: getDocComment
methods.description: Returns null, as documentation comments are not supported.

methods.name: isDeprecated
methods.description: Returns false, indicating the field is not deprecated.

methods.name: getContainingClass
methods.description: Returns the class that contains this field.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the field.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the field.

methods.name: getModifierList
methods.description: Returns the list of modifiers for the field.

methods.name: hasModifierProperty
methods.description: Checks if the field has a specific modifier.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field.

methods.name: getTypeElement
methods.description: Returns null, as type elements are not used.

methods.name: hasInitializer
methods.description: Returns false, indicating no initializer is present.

methods.name: normalizeDeclaration
methods.description: Empty method, no normalization performed.

methods.name: getNameIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a LightIdentifier for the field name.

methods.name: isVisibilitySupported
methods.description: Returns true, indicating visibility modifiers are supported.

methods.name: getElementIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon representing the field, layered with visibility icons.
